pipelines.name: Build project
findings: [MEDIUM] NO_CACHE: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.
[HIGH] UNPINNED_ACTION: Job 'build' step 3 uses unpinned action 'gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4.0.1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
[HIGH] EXCESSIVE_PERMISSIONS: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
[LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'build' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.message: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.
anti_patterns.remediation: Enable built-in caching on setup-* actions (e.g., cache: 'pip' or 'npm') or add an explicit actions/cache step.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'build' step 3 uses unpinned action 'gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4.0.1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'build' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

pipelines.name: Integration Tests

steps.name: Export Supabase env vars
steps.run:
echo "SUPABASE_URL=$(supabase status --workdir integration-test --output json | jq -r '.API_URL')" >> $GITHUB_ENV
echo "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$(supabase status --workdir integration-test --output json | jq -r '.ANON_KEY')" >> $GITHUB_ENV
echo "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=$(supabase status --workdir integration-test --output json | jq -r '.SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

findings: [MEDIUM] NO_CACHE: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.

[HIGH] UNPINNED_ACTION: Job 'integration-test' step 4 uses unpinned action 'supabase/setup-cli@v1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
[CRITICAL] TEMPLATE_INJECTION: Job 'integration-test' step 7 interpolates untrusted event context or writes untrusted data to $GITHUB_ENV/$GITHUB_PATH.
[HIGH] EXCESSIVE_PERMISSIONS: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
[LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'integration-test' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.
[MEDIUM] ARTIFACT_CREDENTIAL_PERSISTENCE: Job 'integration-test' runs actions/checkout without 'persist-credentials: false' and uploads build artifacts.

anti_patterns.remediation: Pass untrusted GitHub context values through intermediate step 'env:' variables, quote shell expansions, and avoid writing untrusted data to $GITHUB_ENV or $GITHUB_PATH.

anti_patterns.remediation: Set 'with: persist-credentials: false' on actions/checkout steps in jobs that upload artifacts.
